messages:
Ivy L: quick alert: our secret-scan found long-lived GitHub PATs checked into a private test repo. No public access, but rotate immediately and update CI to OIDC.

sec-bot: Detected 3 token-like strings in repo test-infra/private-config dated 2026-03-23. Ticket SEC-7812 created, owners DM'd.

Ben R: Which runners use those tokens? Any prod impact?

Ivy L: Only test runners: test-runner-1 and model-sync-test. No prod. Still rotate and revoke old tokens.

ci-eng: Quick steps: revoke PATs in GitHub, create new app token or use OIDC, and update Vault entry. Example:
```
gh auth refresh -h github.com --scopes repo,workflow
vault kv put secret/ci/test-runner token=$NEW_TOKEN
```

platform-ops: I'll block read access to the repo for non-essential accounts while teams rotate.

Ben R: Rotated tokens for test-runner-1, updated Vault, restarted runner. Test jobs green.

Ivy L: Thanks. We'll push a short org policy: disallow long-lived PATs in CI and require OIDC for runners by end of Q2. Draft coming.

sec-bot: SEC-7812 updated with rotation evidence. Closing automated alert after confirmation in thread.

ci-eng: We'll add a lint to the pipeline to fail commits containing token patterns. PR to follow.
